title: Education — course catalog audit
task: Go to https://catalog.mit.edu/subjects/6/, the MIT subject listing for Course 6, Electrical Engineering and Computer Science. Take the first three subjects on that page that are marked U for undergraduate and record for each one: its subject number, its full title, its units line exactly as printed (MIT writes these as three numbers, for example '3-0-9 units'), its prerequisites exactly as written after 'Prereq:', and the terms in which it is offered. Then report those three subjects with all five values, and state how many of the three list a prerequisite other than 'None'. Stop once those three subjects and that count have been reported.

portal.label: Search Catalog
portal.query: Course 6 Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
portal.hint: Browse subjects by department in the 2026-27 catalog.
rows: 6.100A Intro to CS Programming in Python
portal.answer: First three U subjects 6.1000, 6.100A, 6.100B; 1 of the 3 lists a prerequisite other than 'None'
